reviewer.role: independent bounded CODE-PROOF closure and kernel-readiness reviewer

verdict: R3 semantically closes the nine R2 findings at the architecture level: raw bundle persistence and repair identity, disjoint retained roots, separate raw/normalized/config limits, pre-read and atomic-peak accounting, numeric grammar, source coordinates, TOML subset boundaries and successor-only SHA-256 handoff are materially specified. It is not a complete public wire freeze: exact saved-byte identity fields, the full output allowlist and family caps, closed object/target/observation records, config node/span records and successor handoff schema still must be frozen. A pure in-memory Git object kernel can be frozen independently once its exact API, result/error taxonomy, limits and allowed paths are issued.
scope: Read-only review of CODE-PROOF-CLOSURE-R3 against CODE-PROOF-DESIGN-R2, the independent R2 findings, retained Git proof advice, configuration/span advice and canonical integration advice. No source, schemas, tests, Git state, provider, network, connector, Vault or implementation mutation.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: code-git-bundle has no persisted output location or family

points: bundle.json is now a fixed raw-mode output file with one terminal LF
observation binds intent and bundle saved-byte references
intent binds canonical checkout-relative input spelling and complete saved-byte reference
normalized-only mode forbids bundle.json and objects; extra/unsafe/derived entries refuse

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: Freeze exact bundle saved-byte reference field and digest/canonicalization formula, bundle.json schema, output root/path identity, object/config/handoff child family schemas, and the complete output allowlist before public implementation.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: bundle root containment and output overlap under-specified

points: canonical relative path below checkout .work
no symlink, alias, dot/dot-dot component or replaced marker
input and output roots must be disjoint with no equality or ancestor/descendant relation
equal descriptor identities refuse; complete input sets captured before classification; named-edge failures override semantic errors

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: Wire schemas still need the exact root descriptor fields and refusal code/details, but the architecture rule itself is closed.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: deterministic repair lacks persisted external-input identity

points: intent binds request, mode, normalized acquisition metadata and identity
raw intent binds checkout-relative path spelling, complete bundle saved-byte reference and ordered OID/type/size/body/framed inventory
repeat observe re-retains and fully revalidates identity before suffix repair
changed/missing input refuses without writing; normalized-only cannot later add a bundle
late insertion after first absence is unsafe; observation without dependencies is corrupt

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: Freeze canonical intent/bundle identity field names, ordering, digest domain and repair error details. “Ordered inventory” must state whether canonical order is OID order, manifest order, or both.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: per-target text cap conflicts with configuration source cap

points: 16 KiB applies only to inline normalized_text input
raw blobs and normalized hashes from retained raw bytes are not limited by 16 KiB
raw bodies are capped at 8 MiB each and 32 MiB aggregate
configuration-role raw blob has a separate 256 KiB parser limit
larger raw source may retain proof/handoff but emits explicit config limit error and no truncated typed result

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: Public target outcomes must separately encode raw_blob, normalized_text and config_eligible (or equivalent), with raw-byte versus normalized-byte accounting and request-level lower caps. The phrase “raw UTF-8 blob” must not be interpreted as an inline normalized-text result.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: declared object sums and transient atomic-install bytes need explicit proof

points: manifest/object count/declared body sizes/stat sizes checked before body reads
declared aggregate body sum is capped at 32 MiB; tree entries are charged incrementally at 32768
128 MiB peak includes retained files, generated request/intent/bundle/observation/config/handoff bytes and live atomic temps
current retained bytes plus absent targets plus maximum temp duplicate are charged before install
orphan/pending/invalid-name bytes count; one temp is retained/verified/cleaned on every exit

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: The final wire freeze must provide explicit caps for every metadata file and family count, define the concrete maximum temp duplicate, and specify the exact formula/units for all retained descriptors and bundle.json bytes. At most 32 config documents of 2 MiB each is a design bound, not a complete file-family schema.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: numeric lexical and Decimal-context rules remain narrative

points: JSON number grammar is explicit and classifies dot/exponent as decimal
TOML decimal-integer and finite-float grammars expand D/I macros with underscore placement
base integers, nonfinite values, timestamps and other forms refuse
lexeme/coefficient/exponent bounds and context-free Decimal tuple conversion are specified
negative zero, leading zeros, plus/underscore/1. and bool-vs-int behavior are explicit
stdlib cross-check is secondary and cannot expand the subset

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: Freeze scanner token records, canonical numeric value fields, exact Decimal tuple-to-fixed-string algorithm and typed error details in the config packet; add exhaustive vectors for `-0`, `+1`, `1e0`, `01`, `1_000`, `1.`, exponent bounds and nonfinite forms.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: raw/codepoint/line-column coordinate contract needs exact definitions

points: byte/codepoint offsets are zero-based half-open and line/columns one-based exclusive-end
columns are Unicode codepoints, not UTF-16/graphemes/display cells; tabs count one
CRLF is two bytes/codepoints with one line advance; split boundary is invalid; bare CR refuses
raw token spans include source escapes and hash exact bytes; line snippets use physical lines and existing contract
JSON root/container/key/scalar and TOML root/table/header/key/array/inline-table span cases are defined; implicit map values have no synthetic span

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: Freeze the closed node/span record field names, byte/codepoint/line coordinate consistency checks, escaped-token vectors, Unicode/CRLF fixtures and the exact no-span representation in the config schema.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: TOML multiline and key-redefinition boundaries not fully frozen

points: single-line strings/arrays/inline tables plus ordinary tables/dotted keys are the initial subset
multiline strings/arrays/inline tables, arrays of tables, dates/times, base integers and unsupported syntax refuse before tomllib cross-check
comments and same-line array trailing commas are explicitly handled; inline-table trailing comma is refused
decoded-key equivalence, table/value redefinition, implicit-parent promotion and parent boundary rules are stated
deterministic node traversal/order and tree limits are stated

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: Promote the implicit-table promotion/redefinition language into a closed allow/reject vector table and exact error codes. Wire must specify decoded-key collision records, declaration/header spans and array/inline-table boundaries.

semantic_closure_matrix.r2_title: SHA-256 handoff compatibility stated but not wire-bound

points: handoff is successor_only and cannot enter a legacy adapter
exact-width object_format/commit/root-tree/blob IDs, body/raw/framed hashes and source ref are required
path/roles/normalized metadata/walked-edge proof/host assertion/association/config refs are bound
stored blob refs avoid duplicate/reinterpreted source bytes; body SHA is separate from framed hash
legacy 40-hex schemas remain unchanged

semantic_closure_matrix.residual: Freeze exact successor handoff schema fields, types, per-file caps, proof-edge record and refusal when object_format is SHA-256. Public implementation cannot begin from this prose alone.

kernel_freeze_assessment.basis: R3 explicitly permits an independently frozen pure in-memory verifier before transport/config schema freeze (lines 9-14). Raw object framing, OID widths, object/body limits, tree-entry/path-walk limits, target mode policy and consumed-set safety are sufficiently bounded to design that packet.
required_kernel_packet_fields: exact allowed source/test paths and ownership
frame_git_object and git_object_ids signatures and canonical decimal framing
strict in-memory object record/body mapping and target record shapes
object_format/commit/root tree width checks and complete object-set rules
commit/tree parser grammar, tree ordering/name/mode rules and no dereference
present/missing/unsafe/unavailable target result records with consumed object set
typed error enum/details and deterministic precedence
strict integer caps and pre-read declaration checks
static Git-produced/hand-built vectors including SHA-1/SHA-256, symlink/gitlink, missing/intermediate unavailable and extra-object cases
kernel_must_not_include: bundle path safety or retained descriptors
normalized-only mode, config scanner/spans, source handoff or publication
kernel_freeze_assessment.kernel_result: A separately frozen kernel can be implemented and reviewed without claiming CODE-PROOF public workflow completion.

remaining_public_wire_blockers.title: Exact raw output allowlist and family caps
remaining_public_wire_blockers.detail: R3 names four fixed files and three child families but does not publish the complete 12-path allowlist, per-file byte limits, family file counts, canonical child naming, mode/permission fields or unknown-entry refusal shape.

remaining_public_wire_blockers.title: Saved-byte identity and repair digest domains
remaining_public_wire_blockers.detail: “Complete bundle saved-byte reference” and intent identity are semantically required, but exact digest domain, canonical JSON/LF bytes, self-reference exclusion, field order and object-inventory order are not closed.

remaining_public_wire_blockers.title: Closed observation/target/config node records
remaining_public_wire_blockers.detail: Target outcome flags, missing versus unavailable versus unsafe details, config eligibility, numeric node records, span records and exact error detail objects remain prose until successor schemas are frozen.

remaining_public_wire_blockers.title: Concrete peak-accounting constants
remaining_public_wire_blockers.detail: The 128 MiB peak rule is clear, but the exact temporary duplicate bound, descriptor/stat accounting units and metadata family caps remain to be named.

remaining_public_wire_blockers.title: SHA-256 successor handoff schema
remaining_public_wire_blockers.detail: The required semantic fields are listed, but exact field names/types, per-file caps, source-byte refs and legacy-adapter refusal must be schema-bound.

new_or_residual_blockers: No contradiction remains among the nine R2 findings after R3; each is materially answered at the design level.

R3 itself leaves public wire closure explicitly pending. Treating prose such as “ordered inventory,” “saved-byte reference,” “2 MiB config document” or “maximum temporary duplicate” as implementation-ready would create new determinism and accounting ambiguity.
A pure kernel packet is the appropriate next bounded implementation scope, but it must not silently import R3 public path/transport/config semantics or legacy 40-hex capture adapters.
The exact code-git-bundle envelope and output root remain a public I/O contract; this review does not authorize implementing them or the config parser.
required_next_freezes: Freeze the pure in-memory Git kernel packet with exact API, object/target/result/error records, caps, deterministic precedence and allowed paths; then independently review its static vectors.
Freeze public request/intent/bundle/observation schemas and the complete output allowlist, including saved-byte digest domains, family caps, permissions and repair identities.
Freeze normalized/raw/config target outcome fields and explicit raw/config accounting, including the 16 KiB inline normalized versus 256 KiB config-role distinction.
Freeze JSON/TOML scanner, canonical numeric values, node/span records, TOML rejection/promotion vectors and parser cross-check rules.
Freeze successor-only SHA-256 handoff and CODE-CANONICAL relation/publication bindings before any public workflow implementation.
